notes.title: A Letter: Cries Born from Silence
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! [/p][p]After a short break, I’m back to development. During this time, I’ve started taking the first steps toward the game’s story. While not everything is clear yet, the atmosphere is gradually finding its own voice.[/p][p]I’m currently focusing heavily on sound design. Layer by layer, I’m crafting ambient sounds that reflect the spirit of each location, aiming to create an atmosphere that reaches not just the ears but directly the mind.[/p][p]I’ve also begun initial tests for some scenes. These efforts are still behind the curtain for now, but they could become some of the game’s most unforgettable moments — of course, no spoilers just yet. :)[/p][p]I’m working on organizing and giving meaningful purpose to the mansion’s layout. It’s important to me that every corner and detail evokes something for the player. Many ideas are still flying around, but they’re slowly taking shape.[/p][p][/p][p]Your comments, ideas, and support during this process mean a lot to me.
The road is long, but together we move forward stronger.[/p][p][/p][p]ːsteamfacepalmː[/p]
